meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Azure CLI（az quota）查询订阅里各类资源的配额上限、当前用量与剩余可用量，比较不同区域的容量，并可提交配额提升请求。
howto.when: 当你要规划部署、挑选 Azure 区域、查看当前用量，或遇到配额超限错误时触发，例如提到 “check quotas”“quota exceeded” 等。

say.text: 把 eastus 的 standardDSv3Family 配额提到 500
say.note: 提交提升请求，可再查审批状态

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the Azure CLI (az quota) to report quota limits, current usage and available capacity for resources in your subscription, compare capacity across regions, and file quota increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when planning a deployment, picking an Azure region, checking current usage, or hitting quota exceeded errors - e.g. "check quotas", "quota exceeded", "vCPU limit".

say_en.text: Check the Microsoft.Compute quotas and available capacity in eastus
Compare vCPU quota in eastus vs westus2 - which region fits my deployment
Raise the standardDSv3Family quota in eastus to 500
say_en.note: Submits the request; you can check status
